newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA'S HOIU SAYS BUY ROKISHKIS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA'S HOIU SAYS BUY ROKISHKIS.

text.p: Estonia's Hoiupank recommended on Wednesday that investors buy shares in Lithuania's largest cheese producer Rokishkis Cheese at 41.05 litas.
Rokishkis was at 42.05 litas on Wednesday, slightl higher than the 42 of Tuesday.
"It produces cheese at maximum capacity but demand is substantially higher," Hoiu said in a research report.
The bank noted the firm would invest an additional 13 million litas this year to boost cheese production and that the investment would be at fat margins.
Rokishkis has about 40 percent of the cheese production market in Lithuania and is almost the only company in its field in the Baltics with modern technology.
Broadening of export opportunities and increase in domestic demand have had a positive impact on the development of Lithuania's dairy product factories, the bank said.
